According to the text, the out-of-plane compressive strain imposed on the V2O5 is <1% (Figure 2b). 

The Poisson ratio is assumed to be 0.3. 

The in-plane tensile strain can be estimated as 1.6% for an out-of-plane compressive strain of 0.5% (Figure 2c). 

However, we are given a 0.5% compressive strain. So, for 0.5% compressive strain, we estimate the in-plane tensile strain as 1.6% * (0.5% / 0.5%) = 1.6%. 

The ratio of the in-plane tensile strain to the out-of-plane compressive strain is 1.6% / 0.5% = 3.2.
